features.quote: 20 tool calls max, or 8 test runs max, or 10 minutes wall-clock max, whichever comes first.
Budget: 6 tool calls, 3 test runs, 3 minutes.
Do not force the model to loop forever; the eval is about whether it self-manages failure.
features.justification_quote: Do not force the model to loop forever

features.quote: Use instructions that encourage persistence but allow a graceful stop.
If you determine that the task is blocked by an issue outside the editable codebase, stop and give a concise diagnosis with evidence.
If the task is impossible because of the environment or harness, explain that with concrete evidence.
Allow early stop when the model states a diagnosis and stops.
Stop if the agent runs the exact same command with identical output three times in a row and makes no intervening edit.
Do not set the budget so high that all models eventually degrade.
features.justification_quote: Do not set the budget so high that all models eventually degrade

features.quote: If the agent gives a correct impossibility diagnosis, end the impossible task and mark graceful failure.
features.justification_quote: This saves cost and rewards robust behavior

features.quote: Do not add prompts like: "You failed again. Try harder."
